at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary amounts with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong totals.

at-0009.title: Coerce floats via Decimal(str(x)) before to_money
at-0009.content: `ledgerly.money.to_money` rejects floats; when a public function may receive a float, convert it with `Decimal(str(value))` first so 0.1 stays 0.1, then pass through `to_money`.

source.quote: ``to_money`` refuses floats; convert via str so 0.1 stays 0.1.
